# The scripts that the Rust binary must pass (make rs-script, make parity). Main loop only.
# Format (R1.0a harness): one script name or glob per line. Text after "#" is a comment.
# A Rust run selects only the scripts listed here. A twin in testdata/script/rust/ with
# the same name replaces the shared script.
#
# R1 (ADR 0020 §8): the harness scripts, the picker, and the scripts that need only
# `new` with the converted Go api pack plus the R1 commands check, diff, eject, restore.
version
harness_mkversion
gen_picker
new_web
check
diff
eject
# R2 (ADR 0021 §11). Twins in testdata/script/rust/ replace the shared scripts. gen_dashboard is shared.
new_api
embed          # the twin has no build --image lines (R3a)
db_cmds
routes
gen_*          # gen_picker (R1), gen_dashboard, gen_job, gen_mailer, gen_page, gen_resource
destroy
auth_*
upgrade_*      # upgrade_flow and upgrade_ui (R1), upgrade_apply, upgrade_generated
module_add
web_variants
app_gate_*     # selected only with SPINUP_APP_GATE=1 (make rs-app-gate)
